acceptanceCriteria: A documented recipe restores the snapshot by tree hash and `corvint context` reports it fresh, with a test or run showing a mismatched tree forces a rebuild.
A recorded measurement compares cold and warm first-context latency on the Corvint repository.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. Cloud agents (Codex cloud, Copilot coding agent, Claude Code on the web) start from fresh clones and rebuild `.git/corvint/index`. Caching the snapshot keyed by the Git tree hash (for example actions/cache) gives a warm start that cannot be stale for that tree. The snapshot is derived state; a cache miss or mismatched format falls back to `corvint index`. Document the recipe in the triggered-automation contract. Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: ci: warm-start cloud agent sandboxes with the index snapshot cached by tree hash
